thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT — elevated p99 latency on /v1/streaming/generate (hosted) detected. P95 jumped to ~480ms, p99 spiking to 2.1s over the last 3m. Error rate stable, but streaming stalls observed. Auto-escalation to oncall

mira: I'm oncall — looking now. Noted a bunch of 502s in the streaming tail and long auth waits. Paging alex + jen. @alex @jen can you ack?

alex: ack. pulling traces from tracing.redwood -> root cause candidates: auth token service (config fetch) and db connection queuing. grabbing flamegraphs.

jen: ack. noticed DB wait_count up 3x on auth-token-store hosts, connection pool saturated. Logs show lots of slow queries to kv_config (feature flag fetch).

mira: quick customer impact: looks limited to streaming sessions that do model config fetch mid-stream (canary traffic). Affected customers: 2 integrations, ~120k tokens/min during spike. Raising severity to P1.

alex: posting quick findings: p99 spans show auth:token.fetch latency 600-800ms for those requests, plus streaming backend append latency. Sequence: client->front->controlplane->auth->db(kv_config) -> response. KV cache miss rate high.

jen: DB: max_connections on auth-db at 520/512 (exceeded), a few pods OOM? I see retries from connection pool (+50ms). Query sample: SELECT value FROM kv_config WHERE key = 'model:features:xxx' LIMIT 1; full table scan on some rows due to missing index.

alex: snippet of tracing spans (trimmed):
```
span: /v1/streaming/generate (front)
  -> span: auth.token.fetch (600ms)
    -> span: db.kv_config.select (580ms)
```

mira: can we reduce load quickly? mitigation options: 1) increase auth-db pool size (risky), 2) enable local in-memory config cache in controlplane pods (fast), 3) route streaming canary traffic to a fallback model variant that doesn't require config fetch, 4) apply short rate-backoff on config fetches.

alex: we can flip local cache env var in the controlplane deployment to bypass DB for feature flags TTL=30s. Command: kubectl set env deploy/controlplane CACHE_LOCAL=enabled --namespace=prod. Will roll pods and read-only for few seconds.

jen: increasing DB connections is a heavier ops change; prefer app-layer mitigation now. Also creating index on kv_config(key) but that will take longer and needs maintenance window. Running EXPLAIN on the slow query now.

sam: I'm taking notes for handoff. @mira when you handoff to me, I'll coordinate infra if DB needs vertical scaling.

mira: executing local cache flip now, will also throttle config fetch retries to 3 -> 1s backoff. Applying: kubectl rollout restart deploy/controlplane -> starting.

incident-bot: deployment/controlplane rolling restart started (rollout id x-rc-213). Notifying watchers.

alex: after first pod restart, preliminary p99 dropped to 1.1s, p95 ~350ms. Still higher than normal but improving. No increase in error rate.

jen: DB connection count trending down from 520 -> 340 after restart; slow queries reduced. EXPLAIN shows missing index but cache cutting hits by ~70%.

lina: customer comms: pinged CS for the two affected integrations, letting them know we're mitigating and will post a follow-up after root cause + next steps.

mira: rolling restart completed. Watching metrics for 10m. Plan if not stable: fail traffic to fallback model variant (route policy) and open escalation to infra for DB scaling.

alex: also enabling short-term request-level batching reduction for streaming route to avoid tail amplification: set ROUTE_BATCH_MAX=8 -> reduces per-request queueing. Changing config now.

jen: running create index ticket: DB-4579. Will schedule maintenance to add index on kv_config(key) and audit table bloat. For now local cache + reduced batching should hold.

mira: 10m post-mitigation update: p99 ~420ms, p95 ~270ms; streaming stalls largely gone. Marking incident as mitigated. Transitioning to P2 for root cause work.

sam: I'm taking oncall for follow-up. next steps: 1) implement DB index in maintenance window, 2) add metrics for config fetch cache-hit ratio, 3) add circuit-breaker to fallback model for config-timeouts, 4) write postmortem draft.

lina: noted for postmortem: include timeline, customer impact, mitigations (local cache flip, batching change), and comms.

mira: thanks team. handing off to sam for follow-up. closing P1.

sam: ack, taking it. Will ping channel when maintenance window scheduled. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity downgraded to P2, runbook steps recorded.
